name: 119. Logs sort puts missing cost last (logs-null-sort)
description: Sorting /api/logs by cost put rows with no cost (failed, cancelled, count_tokens and list_models requests) first: Postgres sorts NULLs first under DESC, SQLite under ASC, so 'most expensive' on the Logs page and Warp's query_logs led with zero-cost failures. framework/logstore/rdb.go now orders cost and latency NULLS LAST. The seeds put one priced openai request and one provider 404 (logged with no cost) in a fresh session; both reads must list the priced row first. Red before the fix on either backend (the harness profile's SQLite fails the ASC read, Postgres the DESC read). ClickHouse already sorts NULLs last. A NULL-latency row cannot be produced from outside, so latency is covered by the Go test TestSearchLogsSortsMissingCostAndLatencyLast.
